seed_ledger.name: BFC Power and Cheyenne Power Hub (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: EXISTING_ROW: Power Engineering says the first phase of the Tallgrass Cheyenne Power Hub relies on gas from Tallgrass's Rockies Express Pipeline (P0246), tap on that line; Crusoe has since paused its role. Other pipes (CIG, WIC) not named. DataCenter tag lead for P0246.

evidence.note: names Rockies Express as gas source for Cheyenne Power Hub, which serves the Cheyenne data center campus

seed_ledger.name: Desert Sun power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: EXISTING_ROW: APS will supply Desert Sun (2,000 MW west of Gila Bend, phase two for data centers) via the proposed Transwestern Desert Southwest Expansion (Energy Transfer, 1.5 Bcf/d), already row P7840; not El Paso lines. DataCenter tag lead for P7840.

evidence.note: names Transwestern Desert Southwest Expansion as gas supply for Desert Sun; data centers pay for phase two
